scripts.title: ESP Magic Bullet Speed Multiplier Teleport
scripts.features:
This script for the Hunting Season offers a variety of powerful features to enhance your gameplay:

- ESP for live and dead animals with customizable colors.
- Aimbot at the nearest animal with the press of a button ("V").
- A clean, easy-to-use interface to manage all features.
- No key system


**New Features**
- Advanced Animal Tracking (Press T to highlight an animal you aiming at)
- Thermal Scope (Animals glow when aiming )
- Adjustable Scope (You can zoom in and out while aiming)
- Blood Tracker (Wounded animals will glow red)


NOTE: I removed the detectable features such as walkspeed and animal teleportation. Until I found an alternative, it will stay unavailable to prevent account bans.


Disclaimer: I do not own this script, I just updated the script for the owner R-77. Thank you for making this script possible.

           string.find(name, "ship") or
           string.find(name, "invisible") or
           string.find(name, "plane.002") or
		   string.find(name, "plane.003") or
